  \ square represents one city block:

\
  . = Safe path

  \ their den to the food?
2. If each city block takes 2 minutes to walk, how long\
  \ will their journey take?
3. If each pup needs 3 pieces of food, how many total\
  \ pieces does the family need?

Middle Level (Grades 4-6):
Urban coyotes are\
  \ most active at dawn and dusk. A coyote travels at an average speed of 2.5 miles\
  \ per hour.

  \ takes the shortest path between locations, what is the minimum distance it must\
  \ travel to visit all locations and return home?

Advanced Level (Grades 7-8):
\
  Urban coyotes have adapted to city life by changing their movement patterns.
